post.description: Signature-only receiver: rejects browser cookies, Authorization, Origin, query strings, encodings and duplicate protocol headers. GitHub stores body and delivery-ID tombstones across revisions; it cannot prove unseen old payload freshness. Suma binds ingress, timestamp, delivery ID and exact body. Only normalized source facts are retained; no payload-to-command mapping. Receipt and occurrence are committed atomically; dispatch rechecks current ingress/rule authority and fixed workflow.
